source: Overnight oats for two. Combine one cup of rolled oats with one and a quarter cups of milk in a jar. Stir in a tablespoon of chia seeds, a pinch of salt, and a teaspoon of honey. Seal the jar and refrigerate for at least six hours. In the morning, loosen with a splash of milk if the oats have thickened too much, then top with sliced banana and toasted walnuts. The jar keeps for three days. If you prefer a warm bowl, microwave for ninety seconds and stir halfway through.
